summary: Scans triangle strip vertex arrays from a2 to accumulate the X and Z (horizontal-plane) extents, then stores the axis center as the midpoint of each range and an inverse half-extent scale factor as doubles into this. When an axis range is degenerate (zero width) the corresponding scale double is written as zero instead of a reciprocal.

operations.description: Only scan when the count a2[0] is positive.
Outer loop over the strip count from a2[0], with an inner loop of 3 vertices per strip advancing two pointer slots per vertex.
Tighten the running X range using each vertex X value at data[0].
Tighten the running Z range using each vertex Z value at data[3].
Write the X center (midpoint of the X range) as a double at this+0x8 and the X scale as a double at this+0x10, zeroing the scale via its two dwords at this+0x10/this+0x14 when the X range is zero.
Write the Z center (midpoint of the Z range) as a double at this+0x18 and the Z scale as a double at this+0x20, zeroing the scale via its two dwords at this+0x20/this+0x24 when the Z range is zero.

clean_pseudocode: minX = min(minX, p[0]); maxX = max(maxX, p[0]);
minZ = min(minZ, p[3]); maxZ = max(maxZ, p[3]);
